content.title: NEW DELHI, INDIA TRAVEL GUIDE for first-time visitors, places to visit, what to eat, sights
content.text: This is a concise travel guide for New Delhi, in India (2024). The first part is about New Delhi, which time you should visit, about finding accommodation and how to get around, including a couple of places to eat. The second part is a list of top 10 places to visit in New Delhi, including the Taj Mahal and Jaipur. In one week in New Delhi, I could not see everything I wanted, but I met great people and I enjoyed my time a lot.
